scope: Original NumPy port of authors Dense(256)-Dropout(.3)-Dense(128)-Dropout(.3)-Dense(2)-two-qubit/4 BasicEntangler layers-Dense(1) architecture, angle/RX embedding and Pauli-Z readout. Class-weighted gamma=1 focal loss; alpha unused as in the author TensorFlow default. New stratified train/validation/test splits, training-only imputation/scaling and 80-epoch cap with validation early stopping; no paper-score reproduction. Matched eight-parameter classical bottleneck shares encoder/output architecture, parameter count and training recipe, but has a different hypothesis class. Public ILPD benchmark only; no clinical validity claim.

environment.scope: Shared cloud CPU; not student laptop; one BLAS thread.
